SELECT T.YEAR, HR.PERSON_ID, HR.EMPID, HR.LOCAL_NAME, HR.CHINESE_PINYIN, HR.ENGLISH_NAME, HR.KOREAN_NAME, HD.CONTENT DEPTNAME, T.YEAR_TOTAL, T.YEAR_USE_TOTAL, (T.YEAR_TOTAL - T.YEAR_USE_TOTAL) ADJUST_REST FROM AR_ADJUST_REST T, HR_EMPLOYEE HR, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HD WHERE T.PERSON_ID = HR.PERSON_ID AND HR.DEPTNO = HD.DEPTNO(+) AND HD.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND HR.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR#
T.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY')
T.YEAR = #VAC_ID:VARCHAR#
( HR.EMPID LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR HR.LOCAL_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR HR.CHINESE_PINYIN LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR HR.ENGLISH_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR HR.KOREAN_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%')
EXISTS( SELECT * FROM HR_DEPARTMENT WHERE HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO START WITH HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = #DEPTNO:VARCHAR# CONNECT BY PRIOR HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HR_DEPARTMENT.PARENT_DEPT_NO )
(EXISTS( SELECT * FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO AND AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #AR_SUPERVISIOR_INFO:VARCHAR# ) OR HR.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#)
ORDER BY $sortname$ $sortorder$
ORDER BY HD.DEPTNO, HR.EMPID

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM AR_ADJUST_REST T, HR_EMPLOYEE HR, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HD WHERE T.PERSON_ID = HR.PERSON_ID AND HR.DEPTNO = HD.DEPTNO(+) AND HD.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND HR.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR#
T.YEAR = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY')
T.YEAR = #VAC_ID:VARCHAR#
( HR.EMPID LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR HR.LOCAL_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR HR.CHINESE_PINYIN LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR HR.ENGLISH_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%' OR HR.KOREAN_NAME LIKE '%' || #KEY:VARCHAR# || '%')
EXISTS( SELECT * FROM HR_DEPARTMENT WHERE HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO START WITH HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = #DEPTNO:VARCHAR# CONNECT BY PRIOR HR_DEPARTMENT.DEPTNO = HR_DEPARTMENT.PARENT_DEPT_NO )
(EXISTS( SELECT * FROM AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO WHERE AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.DEPTNO = HR.DEPTNO AND AR_SUPERVISOR_INFO.PERSON_ID = #AR_SUPERVISIOR_INFO:VARCHAR# ) OR HR.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR#)

SELECT T.YEAR, HR.PERSON_ID, HR.EMPID, HR.LOCAL_NAME, HR.CHINESE_PINYIN, HR.ENGLISH_NAME, HR.KOREAN_NAME, HD.CONTENT DEPTNAME, T.YEAR_TOTAL, T.YEAR_USE_TOTAL, T.JAN_TOTAL, T.JAN_USE_TOTAL, T.FEB_TOTAL, T.FEB_USE_TOTAL, T.MAR_TOTAL, T.MAR_USE_TOTAL, T.APR_TOTAL, T.APR_USE_TOTAL, T.MAY_TOTAL, T.MAY_USE_TOTAL, T.JUN_TOTAL, T.JUN_USE_TOTAL, T.JUL_TOTAL, T.JUL_USE_TOTAL, T.AUG_TOTAL, T.AUG_USE_TOTAL, T.SEP_TOTAL, T.SEP_USE_TOTAL, T.OCT_TOTAL, T.OCT_USE_TOTAL, T.NOV_TOTAL, T.NOV_USE_TOTAL, T.DEC_TOTAL, T.DEC_USE_TOTAL FROM AR_ADJUST_REST T, HR_EMPLOYEE HR, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HD WHERE T.PERSON_ID = HR.PERSON_ID AND HR.DEPTNO = HD.DEPTNO(+) AND HD.LANGUAGE(+) = #interLanguage:VARCHAR# AND HR.CPNY_ID = #interCpnyID:VARCHAR# AND HR.PERSON_ID = #PERSON_ID:VARCHAR# AND T.YEAR = #YEAR:VARCHAR#
ORDER BY $sortname$ $sortorder$
ORDER BY HD.DEPTNO, HR.EMPID
